key.name: edge-width
key.description: Distance in pixels from the left or right monitor edge that activates a snap zone while dragging a window.

key.name: top-bot-height
key.description: Distance in pixels from the top or bottom work-area edge that activates a snap zone while dragging a window.

key.name: snap-delay-ms
key.description: Milliseconds to wait after releasing the drag before resizing the window. A short delay lets Mutter finish its own drag handling. Lower for snappier feel, raise if windows occasionally snap to the wrong position.

key.name: enable-grid-mode
key.description: When enabled, holding Shift during a drag switches the top and bottom panels into a 6-cell grid. Disable if Shift+drag conflicts with another action.
